primary_meaning: The cross of Christ (as the tree on which he was crucified, bringing redemption from the curse)

alternatives.meaning: Eternal life, immortality, or restored paradise (Tree of Life)
A righteous or flourishing believer (rooted and fruitful)
The fall of humanity or knowledge of good and evil (Tree of the Knowledge of Good and Evil)
Nations, kingdoms, or rulers (as great or lofty trees)

notes: Christian tradition and biblical interpretation assign multiple well-attested symbolic meanings to 'tree,' with the cross and Tree of Life especially prominent in Christology and soteriology; no single exclusive consensus exists across all contexts.
